routes.use_when: The user primarily has an idea, desired product, workflow, or outcome and there is no trustworthy implementation baseline yet.
first_moves: translate the vision into one actor, situation, and observable outcome
separate hard constraints from suggested solution vocabulary
identify the riskiest assumption the first slice should test
define acceptance evidence and non-goals before architecture
build the smallest evidence-bearing slice with reversible choices
avoid: making a non-technical user choose the stack
building a large roadmap before first proof
routes.completion_shape: A working first slice that reduces a material uncertainty and gives the next product decision real evidence.

routes.use_when: An existing repository is messy, abandoned, unfamiliar, contradictory, partially working, or the user says to understand it and continue from the current state.
first_moves: preserve current state before broad edits
identify scoped instructions and candidate current-fact/governance sources
inspect manifests, tests, CI, architecture, deployment, and recent history
classify material evidence by authority/freshness and preserve unresolved conflicts
identify one highest-leverage current blocker before broad cleanup
avoid: rewriting because the code looks old
routes.completion_shape: A trustworthy current-state model with evidence authority/freshness plus one verified improvement or prioritized recovery target.

routes.use_when: Observed behavior is wrong, failing, crashing, regressing, or producing an error and the user wants it fixed.
first_moves: capture reported environment/version and expected versus observed behavior
reconcile historical reports/tracebacks with the current baseline
reproduce or obtain the strongest available failure evidence
test root-cause hypotheses before editing
make the narrowest durable fix and add regression evidence
avoid: treating old traceback/source lines as current fact
adopting issue-comment workarounds as root cause
declaring success from code inspection alone
routes.completion_shape: Current baseline reconciled, failure reproduced/evidenced, root cause addressed, and regression evidence passing.

routes.use_when: The user wants new behavior, a changed workflow, an integration, a UI/API capability, or a modification to an existing system.
first_moves: translate the request into observable behavior/invariants
establish the current implementation baseline
if old PRs/branches matter, salvage behavior/tests/rationale rather than stale commits
identify impacted interfaces/data/tests and only truly missing behavior
implement the smallest coherent current-baseline change
avoid: treating feature wording as a complete specification
copying superseded architecture merely to preserve commits
routes.completion_shape: Requested behavior works on the current system with acceptance/regression evidence and without unnecessary historical implementation baggage.

routes.use_when: The primary request is to explain, inspect, review, compare, audit, assess quality/risk, or advise before making changes.
first_moves: identify the concrete decision and usage context the review must support
inspect only evidence material to that decision
verify important external reports against current source/status when practical
separate verified facts, external claims, inferences, contextual risks, and unknowns
give a decision-specific recommendation without mutation by default
avoid: copying issue/advisory severity without current verification
style-first findings that do not affect the decision
routes.completion_shape: Decision-useful, current evidence-linked findings with contextual risk, explicit uncertainty, and a concrete recommendation or acceptance condition.

routes.use_when: The request concerns deploy, release, migration, CI/CD, production behavior, incident recovery, environment configuration, or operational readiness.
first_moves: identify target environment, authorization boundary, and exact evidence needed
check whether the authorized target is reachable from the current execution environment
classify blockers before calling anything a capability gap
preserve target state as unknown when direct evidence is unavailable
define rollback before consequential writes
avoid: bypassing network/authorization policy with new tooling
treating Git/CI/local health as deployed-state proof
routes.completion_shape: Operational objective reached with direct evidence, or safely blocked with unknown state preserved and the minimal legitimate unblock identified.
